_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Sewers of Ragni#001.src: Soldier! Good timing. We've been requesting help for ages.
The Sewers of Ragni#001.dst: 병사! 마침 잘 왔다. 한참 전부터 지원을 요청했거든.
The Sewers of Ragni#001.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#002.src: With the corrupted hordes terrorising the Wynn Plains, more and more people are moving to {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#002.dst: 타락한 무리가 Wynn 평원을 휩쓸면서 {p}(으)로 옮겨 오는 사람이 점점 늘고 있다.
The Sewers of Ragni#002.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#003.src: Issue is, a major sewage pipe's been blocked up. No wonder nobody wanted the job.
The Sewers of Ragni#003.dst: 문제는 주 하수관 하나가 막혔다는 거다. 아무도 이 일을 안 맡으려 한 게 당연하지.
The Sewers of Ragni#003.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#004.src: I'm going to need you to get your hands dirty. I'll need some assistance with the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#004.dst: 손 좀 더럽혀 줘야겠다. 막힌 걸 뚫는 데 도움이 필요해.
The Sewers of Ragni#004.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#005.src: Here's the brief. We get in, deploy some small explosives to dislodge the blockage, and get out.
The Sewers of Ragni#005.dst: 작전은 이렇다. 들어가서 소형 폭약으로 막힌 걸 날려 버리고 나온다.
The Sewers of Ragni#005.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#006.src: We're using the side pipe. The larger one down the hill, well... you don't want to stray too far into that one.
The Sewers of Ragni#006.dst: 옆 관으로 간다. 언덕 아래 큰 관은, 음... 거긴 너무 깊이 들어가지 않는 게 좋아.
The Sewers of Ragni#006.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#007.src: Keep your wits about you in there. All sorts of things could be lurking. Ready? Let's go!
The Sewers of Ragni#007.dst: 안에선 정신 바짝 차려. 뭐가 숨어 있을지 모른다. 준비됐나? 가자!
The Sewers of Ragni#007.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#008.src: Enter the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#009.src: Explore the sewer and find the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#010.src: Good, you caught up. Watch your step around this place, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#010.dst: 좋아, 따라왔군. 여기선 발밑 조심해, 병사.
The Sewers of Ragni#010.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#011.src: Our scouts have confirmed that this area is clear, but a wrong turn could lead you into the old prison complex.
The Sewers of Ragni#011.dst: 정찰병들이 이 구역은 안전하다고 확인했지만, 길을 잘못 들면 옛 감옥 단지로 이어질 수 있다.
The Sewers of Ragni#011.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#012.src: I... we really don't want to end up there.
The Sewers of Ragni#012.dst: 나... 우린 정말 거기로 가고 싶지 않다.
The Sewers of Ragni#012.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#013.src: Anyway, I've found the blockage. It's right up ahead.
The Sewers of Ragni#013.dst: 아무튼, 막힌 곳을 찾았다. 바로 앞이야.
The Sewers of Ragni#013.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#014.src: Here's a small explosive. I placed this one at the blockage already, if that alone doesn't work, use this.
The Sewers of Ragni#014.dst: 소형 폭약이다. 막힌 곳엔 이미 하나 설치했으니, 그걸로 안 되면 이걸 써.
The Sewers of Ragni#014.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#015.src: Find a way to fix the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#016.src: Find a way out of the spooky sewer.

The Sewers of Ragni#017.src: Ah, you're alive. Looks like we underestimated the amount of sewage.
The Sewers of Ragni#017.dst: 아, 살아 있었군. 오물 양을 얕봤던 모양이다.
The Sewers of Ragni#017.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#018.src: I lost you for a bit back there. It's lucky we found each other, to be honest.
The Sewers of Ragni#018.dst: 아까 잠깐 놓쳤었다. 솔직히 다시 만난 게 운이 좋았지.
The Sewers of Ragni#018.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#019.src: ... ah. This sewer has some history, you know. Back during the {p} Raids, they used to hide civilians here, in the old prison.
The Sewers of Ragni#019.dst: ... 아. 이 하수도엔 역사가 좀 있다. {p} 습격 때 옛 감옥에 민간인들을 숨겼었지.
The Sewers of Ragni#019.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#020.src: Sometimes... sometimes it wasn't enough. Some say there are still... things roaming there. Left over from the slaughters.
The Sewers of Ragni#020.dst: 때로는... 때로는 그걸로도 모자랐다. 아직도 학살에서 남은... 것들이 거기서 떠돈다는 말이 있다.
The Sewers of Ragni#020.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#021.src: Let's get out of here. Do you still have the explosive I gave you?
The Sewers of Ragni#021.dst: 여기서 나가자. 내가 준 폭약 아직 갖고 있나?
The Sewers of Ragni#021.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#022.src: Good, let's use it on this wall, it looks like we can break right through...
The Sewers of Ragni#022.dst: 좋아, 이 벽에 쓰자. 그대로 뚫고 나갈 수 있겠어...
The Sewers of Ragni#022.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#024.src: Phew! Looks like that first explosion cleared the pipe, and the {p} citizens are going to be happy.
The Sewers of Ragni#024.dst: 휴! 첫 번째 폭발로 관이 뚫렸나 보군. {p} 주민들이 좋아하겠어.
The Sewers of Ragni#024.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#025.src: And count yourself lucky we didn't run into anything too nasty in there. Some of the stories...
The Sewers of Ragni#025.dst: 그리고 안에서 험한 것과 안 마주친 걸 다행으로 알아. 들리는 이야기들이...
The Sewers of Ragni#025.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#026.src: ... I don't exactly know what's in there, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#026.dst: ... 거기 뭐가 있는지 나도 잘 모른다, 병사.
The Sewers of Ragni#026.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#027.src: I can't stop you from exploring the dungeon, but I recommend you gear up first.
The Sewers of Ragni#027.dst: 던전 탐험을 말릴 순 없지만, 먼저 장비부터 갖추길 권한다.
The Sewers of Ragni#027.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#028.src: Legend has it that Bob, the legendary warrior, was born in them during a raid on {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#028.dst: 전설에 따르면, 전설의 전사 Bob이 {p} 습격 때 거기서 태어났다고 한다.
The Sewers of Ragni#028.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#029.src: His mother died in childbirth, but some people said she lay down there for years. Rotting. Waiting.
The Sewers of Ragni#029.dst: 어머니는 출산 중에 죽었는데, 몇 년이나 그 아래 누워 있었다는 말이 있다. 썩어 가며. 기다리며.
The Sewers of Ragni#029.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#030.src: But that's just a story! Thanks for your help, soldier, and good luck.
The Sewers of Ragni#030.dst: 하지만 그냥 이야기일 뿐이다! 도와줘서 고맙다, 병사. 행운을 빈다.
The Sewers of Ragni#030.speaker: Jenprest
